name: Where the Record Starts

levels.entry: The archive is four hundred and eleven years old and complete. I have never seen anything like it.
Four hundred and eleven years ago is the Shattering. The record begins the year the world broke.
Which is reasonable -- that is when they started measuring. It is also the one year you would least want as your first.
Every normal in these volumes is a post-Shattering normal. The rainfall they call average, the riverflow they call standard, the coastline they call the coastline.

Vessa knows. She has known for some time and has not been able to say it in a form the halls would accept, because the form the halls accept is a measurement, and you cannot measure a thing you were not there for.
The plateau is covered in evidence from before: the terraces, the quarry section, the marks on the stones, the herders' years. None of it is a measurement, so none of it is in the archive.
The archive is not wrong. It is a perfect record of the wound, kept by careful people who mistook it for the body.

notes: The thesis. Seven rungs, and gated on two other discoveries so it cannot be reached by walking into the building -- the player has to bring the plateau's evidence in with them. Deliberately sympathetic to the University in the last line.
